description.value: Your folio contains a contract with one of the hellmouths, enormous living portals connected to Hell itself. You can cast a 6th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Teleport] once per day as a divine innate spell. By spending 8 hours poring over your contracts, you can instead cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Interplanar Teleport] but can only travel to Hell (and not back).

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance
